svg.aria-label: Survey bulletin: THIORORUX-V, class: Lava Garden. Inhabitants: three (3) small, damp dragons who build cathedrals out of their own echoes. Advisory: Do not answer the humming.
svg.title: THIORORUX-V — Outer Survey Office bulletin No. 5
svg.text: FORM PS-7 · DAILY PLANETARY BULLETIN · No. 5
Three (3) small, damp dragons who build
cathedrals out of their own echoes.
It rains the sound of applause every eleven
“Took a sample. The sample took one of us.” —
